name: When is priming necessary during interior painting preparation?

mainEntity.name: When is priming necessary during interior painting preparation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Priming is necessary in several situations to ensure the best paint finish. You should always prime bare drywall or patched areas to seal the surface and prevent uneven paint absorption. Priming is also crucial when changing a dark wall color to a much lighter one, or when painting over stains like water damage or smoke, as it helps block them from bleeding through the new paint. Additionally, if you're painting over glossy finishes, a bonding primer will help the new paint adhere better. Considering these factors is a key decision point for achieving a professional look.
acceptedAnswer.description: Priming is essential for bare drywall, patched areas, changing dark colors to light, covering stains, or painting over glossy finishes.
